text:
manuel: Quick run-through of the dashboard chart tweaks. Main UX friction: long Y-axis units + overlapping tick labels on compact rows.
priya: Yep. On 3-column small-multiples the Y labels collide and we get visual noise.
cory: Proposal: trim axis labels with ellipses (e.g. 1,234,5...?) and reveal full value on hover/keyboard focus. But ensure screen reader sees full number.
june: I'd avoid visual ellipses that lose magnitude context. Instead show abbreviated unit suffixes (K/M/B) and a toggle in settings: full numbers vs abbreviated.
manuel: Agree with a toggle. Could default to abbreviated and add a tiny "1234" affordance in tooltip for full values.
priya: Also axis tick density: add a "smart ticks" option that favors round numbers and prevents label overlaps. Default = smart.
cory: Smoothing rename idea: current label "smoothing" is ambiguous. What about "Curve-fit (visual)" and a separate "Reduce samples (performance)"? Put short help text beneath each.
june: Love the naming. Also add an inline hint under curve-fit: "May hide short-lived spikes" with a link to "Inspect raw values".
manuel: Outliers: instead of clipping the axis we should keep full scale but dim outlier points and add a small caret marker when a point is off-scale for auto-scale. Hover shows original value + reason.
priya: UX for outlier threshold editor: slider + live histogram of recent values so users can see distribution. When you move slider, histogram updates and a sample sparkline shows before/after scaling. Very helpful for non-technical folks.
cory: Dev note: avoid per-point DOM changes. Use canvas shader uniform for global alpha and a mask texture for selective dimming. I'll coordinate with eng-runtime.
a11y-bot: Accessibility notes: 1) Axis tick values must include full numeric value in aria-label; 2) abbreviation suffixes should have aria-describedby explaining multiplier; 3) curve-fit toggle needs aria-pressed or aria-checked state; 4) outlier marker should be keyboard-focusable with a brief announcement like "data point dimmed: 1,234,567, reason: above 99.9th percentile".
june: Microcopy: for the curve-fit hint I propose: "Curve-fit smooths short variations for trend clarity; disable to inspect raw spikes." Keep it <100 chars.
manuel: For legend compacting: show series as compact chips with color swatch + short name; add "More" pill that expands into a scrollable list. On expand, focus the first row.
priya: When collapsed show a counter e.g., "Series (4)". Make sure collapsed container has fixed height so rows align in small-multiples.
cory: Implementation: collapsed chips container with overflow-x auto on mobile; on desktop use right-side rail.
a11y-bot: Add checklist item: "collapsed legend preserves tab order; expand moves focus to first entry; collapsed state exposes series count in accessible name".
june: Quick copy tweak for outlier tooltip: change "excluded" -> "dimmed by auto-scale" and include severity (e.g., 99.9th pct).
manuel: Action items: Priya to write toggle copy + unit-abbrev aria examples; Cory to draft perf note for shader mask approach; June to prepare microcopy variants (curve-fit, outlier tooltip); A11y-bot will add checklist entries and example announcements.
priya: I'll post copy options in #design and add a tiny Figma frame.
cory: I'll open an issue in eng-runtime with proposed mask texture approach and perf estimates.
june: I'll mock the histogram-threshold slider and sparkline preview.
a11y-bot: Checklist summary: "axis aria full values; abbrev aria-description; curve-fit aria state; collapsed legend focus behavior; outlier marker keyboard announce".
manuel: Thanks team  aiming to get designs merged this sprint. :rocket:
